screen: Title card: Wedora logo over a soft festive background; small line 'Built today at Festive Hacks'
voiceover: Hello judges. The venue is noisy, so an AI voice reads our narration. Everything you see is ours, built today.

screen: Two big words animate in: Money / Who does what. A crossed-out long wedding checklist fades behind them
voiceover: We don't plan the whole wedding. We fix two things that break every Indian family wedding: money, and who does which task.

screen: Org diagram: Family Admin at top, six department boxes (Finance, Logistics, Food & Catering, Decoration, Guest Management, Events & Ceremony), each with head, sub-heads, members; an expense card flows to the right approver
voiceover: One admin, six departments, heads and members. Expenses go to the right approver by amount; only whoever must act is notified.

screen: Story card: Mohanty family, Cuttack. Priya & Rahul, 12 December, budget ₹18,00,000. The family mixes English and Hindi.
voiceover: Our story: Priya Mohanty's wedding in Cuttack, eighteen lakh budget. Papa is most comfortable in Hindi.

screen: Admin onboarding in English: Wedora asks each question aloud; Papa's spoken answer is heard.
voiceover: Papa picks Hindi. Wedora, a calm AI operations manager, asks each question aloud, and Papa answers by voice. Listen.

screen: Confirm card fills: Priya, Rahul, 12 Dec, Cuttack, budget ₹18,00,000.
voiceover: Sarvam fills a confirm card, even eighteen lakh said in Hindi. AI proposes; the family confirms.

screen: Ceremony suggestions and starter tasks per department; WhatsApp invite links for heads.
voiceover: Flagsmith serves Hindi ceremonies for his language. Sarvam suggests starter tasks, and heads get WhatsApp invites.

screen: Second phone: Mamu opens his invite link, taps বাংলা; short Decoration-only onboarding, spoken in Bengali
voiceover: Mamu opens his invite, picks his language, and sees only his own department.

screen: Admin dashboard: ₹18 lakh budget bar with approved / waiting / remaining; six department tiles with head, tasks done, spend
voiceover: The dashboard shows eighteen lakh: approved, waiting, remaining, with every department's progress.

screen: 'Who joined' tree (level, invited by, time); invite links list with uses and a Revoke button; then a member's home with only their tasks and expenses
voiceover: Who joined, invited by whom, and when. Members see only their work.

screen: Sponsor card 'Sarvam AI': speech turning into text, latency badge ~0.3 s.
voiceover: First, Sarvam. Saaras turns Hindi, English and other Indian languages into text in about zero point three seconds.

screen: Diagram: speech → sarvam-105b with strict JSON schema → proposal card (no direct write) → translation → Bulbul voice; badge 'full voice turn 1–2 s on server'
voiceover: Sarvam's one-oh-five B model proposes through strict schemas, never writing directly. Bulbul speaks each translated line. A voice turn: one to two seconds.

screen: Sponsor card 'Flagsmith'; Flagsmith dashboard with segments Admin / Head / Sub-head / Member; flags: budget_dashboard, invites, ai_task_planner, voice
voiceover: Flagsmith sets each family level's powers, on our server, from the database. Nobody can fake their level.

screen: Live: in Flagsmith, voice toggled ON for the Member segment; cut to member's phone, mic button appears (timer ~10 s)
voiceover: Members have no voice. Watch: we switch it on in Flagsmith, and the mic appears within ten seconds.

screen: approval_limits JSON (sub-head ₹5,000, head ₹25,000); an approval card with 'Why this came to you'; ceremony_suggestions by language; ai_voice kill switch
voiceover: Approval limits, five and twenty-five thousand, stay server-side. Each approval card explains why it came to you.

screen: Sponsor card 'NudgeBee'; runbook built with nubi: every-minute health check of Wedora; clock showing 11 pm, night before the wedding
voiceover: NudgeBee guards the night before the wedding. Using Nubi, NudgeBee's AI, we built a runbook that checks Wedora every minute.

screen: Outage drill ON → runbook runs → approval request → Approve → ai_voice OFF in Flagsmith, HIGH event logged → app mic disappears, buttons shown
voiceover: If Sarvam is down, it asks the operator; on approval, it turns AI voice off in Flagsmith, logging a high event. Families see buttons instead.

screen: Live conversation: Arjun (Decoration sub-head, app in English) taps Talk with Wedora.
voiceover: Now the finale, a live, hands-free conversation. Bapi tells Wedora, in Hindi, that the tent vendor was paid twelve thousand. Listen.

screen: Mamu's approval card for the ₹12,000 tent payment, 'Why this came to you'.
voiceover: He says yes. Wedora asked before saving any money, recorded it, and sent it to Mamu, the Decoration head, because it is above five thousand.

screen: Mamu's phone: approval card, taps Approve; admin dashboard Decoration spend updates; then 'How much has Decoration spent?' answered from the database
voiceover: Mamu approves on his phone; the dashboard updates. Decoration's spending? Answered from the database.

screen: Close-up of the confirm prompt; text 'Money is always confirm-first'
voiceover: Money is always confirm-first. That's the part we're proudest of.

screen: Checklist: row-level security on every table, no keys in the app, per-user AI limits, privacy notice for younger relatives
voiceover: Security, checked before launch: row-level security everywhere, no keys in the app, per-user AI limits, and a privacy notice.

screen: End card: yubaraj2000.github.io/wedora, Android APK badge, 'AI-assisted build disclosed in README', Wedora logo
voiceover: Live at yubaraj two thousand dot github dot io slash wedora, plus an Android APK. The README discloses our AI-assisted build. Thank you, from our family to yours.
